title: Mukesh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, J.; Jayant Banerji, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; liberty to object under para 6.8; coercive action stayed eight weeks.
headnote: A writ seeking tubewell supply and quashing of a Rs. 1,63,061 demand was disposed without merits. The consumer was left to object under paragraph 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, with time-bound disposal after hearing and a limited stay of coercive recovery.
facts: Mukesh approached the Allahabad High Court seeking a mandamus to supply electricity to his tubewell and certiorari to quash a demand notice of Rs. 1,63,061. Counsel for the distribution licensee stated that the petitioner could file an objection against the demand, to be decided within a time-bound period. The Court did not examine the merits and disposed of the writ, leaving the consumer to object under paragraph 6.8 of the Supply Code, with a limited stay of coercive recovery.

holding_units.topic: paragraph 6.8 objection as alternate remedy to writ against demand
holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on merits, a writ challenging a demand of Rs. 1,63,061 and seeking tubewell connection is disposed of with liberty to submit an objection under paragraph 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within four weeks; the authority shall decide it in accordance with law within the next four weeks after hearing, and coercive action on the demand stands stayed for eight weeks or until disposal of the objection, whichever is earlier.

principle_tags.application: Writ against a Rs. 1,63,061 demand (and for tubewell connection) disposed without merits; consumer given liberty to object under paragraph 6.8, with time-bound disposal after hearing and a limited stay of coercive recovery.
Mandamus and certiorari refused on the electricity dispute; the consumer was relegated to the statutory paragraph 6.8 objection before respondent No. 3.
Challenge to the impugned electricity demand was sent to the paragraph 6.8 objection route rather than decided on the writ.

not_decided.point: Merits of the impugned demand of Rs. 1,63,061
not_decided.note: No opinion expressed; relegated to a paragraph 6.8 objection.
Writ disposed without grant or refusal of the connection prayer.
